packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major updates
springdoc updates can change the generated OpenAPI document and need make generate; declared after the non-major rule so this group wins
Bump by hand to the newest release whose POM declares the opentelemetry-api version Spring Boot manages (rule C7); a newer appender breaks linkage against Boot's older OpenTelemetry API
The observability stack charts and images are checked together by make obs-up
TanStack Router packages must move together; declared after the non-major rule so this group wins
The Playwright npm package and browser image must be the same release; declared after the non-major rule so this group wins
MCR tags carry no release timestamp, so the 7-day gate would hold this image forever; the npm package keeps the gate
quay.io gives no release timestamps, so the 7-day gate would hold this image forever; treat the timestamp as optional
The kindest/node digest must come from the kind release notes; bump it by hand together with KIND_VERSION

Stay within the kind node's Kubernetes minor; raise this together with the node image. registry.k8s.io gives no release timestamps, so the 7-day gate holds kubectl updates indefinitely; bump by hand (no timestamp-optional without the owner)
CloudNativePG operand tags look like 18.6-202611090812-minimal-trixie; a major upgrade needs a planned pg_upgrade
Cluster-breaking updates stay out of the general non-major PR; the cluster-e2e job gates them.

customManagers.description: Versions annotated with '# renovate:' in deploy/versions.mk
Image pins next to a '# renovate:' comment in the Kubernetes manifests
Calico release named in the version comment under the renovate annotation; the commit SHA in the URL is updated together with it
